title: deferred-capacity-fuse-and-tenant-throttle-sentinel
author: Isabella Gomez
release_notes: Adds a deferred capacity fuse to avoid cascade decommits during short-lived overloads; introduces a tenant throttle sentinel that enforces soft backpressure with safety gating; exposes sampled utilization windows and percentile telemetry for better SLA correlation.
body: Summary: Implements a short-term 'capacity fuse' that defers node/pool decommit decisions for a configurable stabilization window and a 'tenant throttle sentinel' that applies conservative soft-throttles when tenant tail-latency or error spikes correlate with transient headroom loss. Motivation: We've observed several production incidents where rapid decommitments after a brief surge caused a negative feedback loop (reduced capacity -> higher latency -> more throttles -> further decommits). The fuse prevents churn for brief spikes and gives autoscalers time to stabilize; the sentinel provides an immediate safety action to protect shared capacity while telemetry surfaces signal details.
commits: feat: add capacity fuse controller and config (controllers/fuse.go, pkg/controllers/README)
feat: tenant throttle sentinel with safety gates and token bucket backpressure (controllers/throttle_sentinel.go)
perf: sampled utilization window v2 and percentile exporter (pkg/telemetry/sample_window.go)
files_changed: controllers/fuse.go - new controller implementing deferred decommit state machine and reconcile loop
controllers/throttle_sentinel.go - tenant-level monitor and soft-throttle reconciler
pkg/telemetry/sample_window.go - reservoir-based sampled window for P50/P90/P99 exports
config/defaults.yaml - new feature toggles and default windows
tests/e2e/deferred_capacity.yaml - scenario with synthetic spike and recovery
docs/operators/deferred-fuse.md - operator-facing runbook and tuning guide
docs/observability/telemetry-sampled-windows.md - telemetry contract and example Grafana queries
CHANGELOG.md - entry for deferred capacity fuse and sentinel
testing: Unit: controllers/fuse_test.go covers state transitions, edge cases for overlapping spikes
Integration: throttle sentinel integrated with token-pool simulator; validates soft-throttle does not exceed safety caps
E2E: test scenario reproducing transient surge then recovery to assert no decommit within stabilization window
configuration: throttle_sentinel.soft_throttle_pct (default: 20) - percentage of tenant concurrency to softly throttle
observability: telemetry.sampled_window.v2: emits percentiles with reservoir sampling for last N seconds
sentinel.actions: counter of soft-throttles and safety-blocks
dashboards: new pane on Dedicated -> Capacity showing deferred decisions and sampled P99
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured stabilization_window can delay needed scale-downs, temporarily increasing cost. Mitigation: defaults are conservative (30s) and operator-visible metrics; we added a kill-switch feature gate and a simple rollout plan (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%). Also added automated alert if fused decommits exceed configured budget.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature gated behind 'deferred-fuse' flag. 2) Enable on a small dedicated region (canary) for 48h. 3) Monitor sentinel.actions, fuse.events, and utilization histograms; iterate config. 4) Gradual ramp to remaining regions with rollback on regression.

merge_commit_message:
squash: deferred capacity fuse + tenant throttle sentinel

Adds a stabilization fuse to avoid cascade decommits and a tenant-level soft-throttle sentinel. Includes sampled telemetry windows for percentile exports and operator docs.
notes: Operator docs include tuning examples for latency-sensitive tenants and cost-aware tuning. Follow-up PR planned to expose a per-tenant advisory API for external autoscalers.
related_issues: ENG-1482: Reduce cascade decommits during transient spikes
changelog_entry: Feature: Deferred capacity fuse to stabilize decommit behavior; Feature: Tenant throttle sentinel with soft backpressure; Telemetry: Sampled utilization window v2 for percentile exports.
egress_instructions: After merge: bump chart version, run helm upgrade for canary pool, monitor 'fuse.events' and 'sentinel.actions' for 48h. If metrics show regressions, set deferred_fuse.enabled=false and redeploy.
incident_ties: Linked to historical incident INC-2025-04 where rapid decommits following a traffic spike caused sustained latency increases; this PR implements a safety pattern recommended by SRE postmortem.
support_notes: Support runbook added at docs/operators/deferred-fuse.md including commands to inspect current defer state (redwoodctl capacity fuse status) and to force-evict if necessary.
extra_context: We opted against a purely heuristic hold (based on X% utilization) and instead implement an explicit fuse state machine to make reasoning deterministic across clusters. This simplifies audits and customer explanations when a decommit was intentionally deferred. The implementation deliberately keeps decision windows small to balance cost and stability.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-1612: Add per-tenant advisory API for external autoscalers
ENG-1624: Expose fused-decommit telemetry to Console with alerting template
